description: A singleton class that manages the caching of coin data using a database and handles cache invalidation and refreshing based on timestamps.

classes.name: CacheManager
classes.description: Manages the local cache of coin data, handles cache refresh logic and database transactions.

methods.name: shouldRefreshCache
methods.description: Determines if the cache should be refreshed based on the last updated time of coin data.

methods.name: invalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates the cache by deleting all coins from the database.

methods.name: clearOldCache
methods.description: Clears coins that are older than 7 days from the cache.
